entries.lesson_core_move: Represent automobile motion as a continuous-time input-output system by selecting physical input and output signals and expressing their relationship as a system rule such as integrating acceleration to obtain velocity or position.

images.section_title: Introduction to Automobile Motion as a System
images.image_description: Minimal line-art one-dimensional car-motion schematic showing a car moving along a straight road with three labeled signals, $a(t)$, $v(t)$, and $x(t)$, plus arrows indicating the signal mapping from acceleration into an integrator block, then to velocity, and from velocity into a second integrator block, then to position. Emphasize input-output direction and keep the diagram simple and instructional.
missing_information: No style guidance exists in the shared guide for line-art car or block-diagram system flow visuals.
new_visual_elements: Car-motion scene/vehicle icon and directional road context
Custom signal-processing block symbols for integrator operators
Schematic arrow-labeled mapping ($a(t)$ -> integrator -> $v(t)$ -> integrator -> $x(t)$) style not in existing templates
